body:
My research question has been further refined in a new direction focusing on culture, identity, language, and communication. The reason for the change comes primarily to remove the AI as the center of my previous concept stepping into a more diverse and narrow research direction. 

The previous concept was too broad for a research that needed to be more specific. This would have made it harder to research and even convert into a form the fully represented the idea; considering that it was something that could take a lot of time to perform individually. 

The research question I am exploring now is : "How do people adapt culturally specific expressions when communicating across languages, and what meanings do speakers and listeners perceive as lost, gained, or changed in the process?"
